answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a foundational relic for validating individual actors within an AI swarm. By requiring agents to solve a unique cryptographic cipher tied to biometric or social graph data, the network enforces a one-agent-one-vote constraint. This structure creates an orchard of verified identities, where the cost of an attack scales linearly with the acquisition of authenticated credentials, rendering the creation of infinite malicious aliases economically prohibitive.
